ThingDef.label: Storm King's spear
ThingDef.description: Grants 100% damage against enemies and 3 chain levels. Every third valid direct hit creates a storm with a 4-cell radius at the target. Deals 120 + 50% of this hit's direct damage as additional damage to up to 8 standing enemies. Storm cooldown: 1 second. A reward from the Thunder dome trial. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

ThingDef.label: Stormwall
ThingDef.description: Grants 150% health and +0.6 damage-taken divisor. While a standing enemy is within 24 cells, grants a 120-point shield about every 5 seconds, lasting 6 seconds. When a shield absorbs damage, strikes up to 4 enemies within 10 cells for 80 + 30% of the amount absorbed as additional damage each. Discharge cooldown: 1 second. A reward from the Thunder dome trial. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

ThingDef.label: Starfall maul
ThingDef.description: Grants 140% damage against enemies, 80% health and 2 burn levels. Every fourth valid direct hit strikes up to 10 standing enemies within 5 cells of the target for 100 + 25 × the wearer's current health multiplier as additional damage, and applies level 3 burn. Shockwave cooldown: 1.5 seconds. A reward from the Furnace depths trial.

ThingDef.label: Furnace armor
ThingDef.description: Grants 200% health and 3 ordinary injury points healed per second. After taking direct damage from an enemy, gains a shield of 200 + 10 × current health multiplier for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 3 seconds. This shield cannot absorb the hit that triggered it. A reward from the Furnace depths trial.

ThingDef.label: Lantern of souls
ThingDef.description: Grants 3 soul-harvesting levels and 2.5 ordinary injury points healed per second. Killing a standing enemy fires soul bolts from its position at up to 3 enemies within 12 cells. Each takes 60 + 3 × the wearer's soul marks as additional damage. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Soul bolts cannot trigger further soul bolts. A reward from the Hall of souls trial. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

ThingDef.label: Soulward seal
ThingDef.description: Grants 150% health and 3 ordinary injury points healed per second. After augments or relics heal 120 actual injury points, grants 180-point shields to up to 4 free colonists within 12 cells for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Excess healing does not count. A reward from the Hall of souls trial.
